stem: Sedimentary rock is formed through several different processes. Match each process with its description.
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box.
response_template:
Materials in the Earth’s crust break down into smaller pieces. [blank_1]

Particles of sediment begin to stick to each other and are eventually held together by clay and other minerals. [blank_2]

Water, ice, wind, or gravity moves fragments of rocks and soil from one place to another. [blank_3]

Layers are squeezed together, and any water mixed in with the sediments is forced out. [blank_4]

Sediments are laid down in new locations. [blank_5]
